questions.title: Which country will win the men's basketball bronze medal at the 2026 Asian Games?
questions.background: This question concerns the five-on-five basketball tournament, rather than the separate three-on-three competition.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Asian Games competition results or reliable contemporaneous reporting of the completed bronze-medal match.

  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's short English name.

  • Resolution: Identify the opposing national team in the match that eliminates China from contention for the men's football gold medal. Any subsequent bronze-medal match is excluded. If China wins gold, resolve to no country.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The opposing country's name, or “None” if China wins gold.
